mines.mine_notes: PEA (announced Jul 21, 2025, base case US$2,500/oz Au, C$1.43/US$1): after-tax NPV5% C$743M (pre-tax C$1,273M), after-tax IRR 56.3% (pre-tax 128%), after-tax payback <2 yrs. 15-yr LOM in 3 phases: Phase 1 (yrs 1-4) open pit 700 tpd trucked to offsite mill (Pine Cove Mill selected Jan 26, 2026), initial capital C$154.8M, 69.3 koz/yr avg at AISC US$1,282/oz; Phase 2 (yrs 5-15) 7,000 tpd on-site plant (commissioning yr 5), 129.0 koz/yr avg at AISC US$1,206/oz (yrs 5-13), incl. 172.2 koz/yr at US$1,090/oz first 5 processing yrs; Phase 3 (yrs 6-10) high-grade UG cut-and-fill 700 tpd. Total: 27,373 kt mill feed @ 1.85 g/t Au, contained 1,626 koz, recovered 1,494 koz (91.9%); avg 99.6 koz/yr; LOM cash cost US$1,085/oz; LOM sustaining US$171/oz; LOM AISC US$1,256/oz; growth capital C$584.9M; sustaining capital C$325.4M; mine net revenue US$4,924M; EBITDA margin 59.8%. Initial production targeted 2027 pending regulatory approval. Phase I EPCM contract signed Jan 26, 2026 (WSP). Going-concern qualification on 40-F audit report. FY2025: no production at Queensway; net loss C$143.3M.
mines.processing: Phase 1: offsite mill (Pine Cove Mill); Phase 2: 7,000 tpd on-site plant (crushing, grinding, flotation, cyanide leach of flotation tailings, doré on site)

mines.mine_notes: Acquired Nov 13, 2025 via Maritime Resources statutory plan of arrangement (94,254,209 New Found Gold shares, C$275.2M). Includes Hammerdown deposit and Pine Cove milling/tailings facilities. Pre-commercial production in FY2025 generated C$5.80M production revenue; mining operations had not reached commercial production at year end. Post-FY (Feb 26, 2026) updated MRE + PEA announced for hub-and-spoke plan (Hammerdown, Stog'er Tight, Orion) around Pine Cove Mill: after-tax NPV5% C$199.2M @ US$3,475/oz Au (C$415.1M @ US$5,000/oz), 251.3 koz over 13-yr LOM, cash cost US$2,149/oz, AISC US$2,429/oz, after-tax free cash flow C$243.3M.

notes: Emerging Canadian gold producer (Newfoundland & Labrador). Initial MRE Queensway announced Mar 24, 2025; PEA announced Jul 21, 2025. Maritime acquisition closed Nov 13, 2025, adding Hammerdown/Pine Cove. FY ended December 31, 2025. 40-F filed Mar 25, 2026. Report URL not retained (downloaded from EDGAR 40-F package).
